show.description:
A single mother returns to her family home, only to face old wounds and relentless criticism for her life choices.
But with the strength of raising three successful sons on her own, she refuses to bend under judgment.
This is a moving tale of resilience, love, and reclaiming joy in the face of toxic family dynamics.
